title: Key collisions: [ and ] switch projects, a/A/+ split, drop the n and p row aliases

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Frontend design review of 2026-10-25 (opus, from four owner screenshots; it did not read docs/dashboard.md or adj 149, so check the spec first). The owner chose (adj 160, ui.project-keys, to be decided): [ and ] switch projects everywhere (wrapping through Needs you as left/right do today); left/right belong to in-view tabs and fields; a stays Approve, A toggles all projects on Decisions, + adds a project on Welcome; the n and p row aliases are dropped (n is No in confirms). Revises the key part of adj 112 and 120. Check adj check ui.project-keys is decided before running.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/keys.go`, `model.go`, `view.go` (hint and help text), `welcome.go`, `decisions.go`, `lineup.go` (left/right stay field keys there), `questions.go`.
- `internal/tui/*_test.go`, `testdata/golden/` (view bar and help goldens), `docs/dashboard.md`, `docs/design.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestBracketsSwitchProjectsAndWrapThroughNeedsYou.
- TestLeftRightDoNotSwitchProjects (they are inert on Overview, Roadmap, Waves, Questions).
- TestDecisionsLeftRightSwitchTabs still holds; TestAllProjectsToggleIsCapitalA; TestWelcomeAddIsPlus.
- TestNAndPNoLongerMoveRows: n answers No in a confirm and moves nothing elsewhere.
- Help and hint text list the new keys; goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Check `adj check ui.project-keys`; stop if it is not decided. 2. Tests first. 3. Rebind in keys.go and handlers. 4. Update the help text, docs and goldens. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner looks at the changed view in a live terminal at 100x30 and 80x24.
